shows: minimap (3-D, rotates with camera, revealed tiles, boss heads & quest givers)

land-caption.desc: land name fades in on entering (2012-07)

combo-counter.desc: near cursor; blue with '!' at cap

crosshair.desc: no target lock (lock-on existed Nov 2011 only)

enemy-names.desc: colour by relative power (A) / tier (S) + optional stars; friendly = light blue + wave; other players' level on highlight (0.9.3-0)

world-map.desc: 3-D voxel map, rotate/zoom (1:4..1:256 S); near zoom = terrain miniature (structures visible as voxels + names), far = landmarks; players as heads, missions as icons, markers, shrines as blue dots, flight points as +; A: unexplored uniform blue per land, explored trail lighter; S: full colours everywhere, white flashing current land border, land selector arrows, coordinates; move while open

overview-map.desc: schematic lands + levels (blue ocean, green own level, red higher, grey lower)

extras: S weapon/armor star rating at left

quick-select.desc: wheel of potions/food/bombs; A/D cycle; count shown

customization-bench.desc: rotate weapon M3, drag cubes onto voxel model; drag out destroys

character-creation.desc: race, gender, class, head, hair, hair colour, name; random background (A)

world-selection.desc: character select → world select → seed entry

esc-menu.desc: icon bar with hotkeys; help button (0.9.3-0)

item-tooltip.desc: name (rarity colour) + material + type + +N (A); stats; sell price (A, removed 0.9.1-4); red name = wrong class; stars per rarity display option

camera.mode: third person, wheel zoom; full zoom-in = first person (kept, D9)
